baseline_policy: User quality status is not baseline promotion. Respectful means worth preserving and continuing, not finished or release-ready.

productions.title: LAX — Final Approach
productions.notes: Paused on v11. Worth resuming when the user is specifically asking for airplane flight, approach, landing, rollout, or closely related aviation work; do not continue it by default. Direction/orientation and major ground/environment failures were materially repaired, and v11 rebuilt 22-65s, but the current user quality state remains below respectful. Next work: review v11, raise native motion cadence beyond 6fps, repair early ground/z-fighting artifacts, finish touchdown/gear/control-surface physics, improve environment/lighting continuity and aviation audio. Resume handoff: docs/LAX_FINAL_APPROACH_HANDOFF.md.
